title: Add a copy-answer action to assistant chat messages
goal: Let users copy a complete assistant response to the clipboard directly from the message bubble, alongside the existing share action.
context: Assistant responses are selectable text and shareable, but there is no explicit copy affordance. A copy button makes it faster to reuse answers in notes, code editors, and other apps.
forbidden_changes: Do not change message persistence, generation, or provider behavior.
Do not add clipboard access for user messages.
Do not remove the existing Share answer action or selectable text.
Do not claim physical-device acceptance without testing a real iPhone.
acceptance_criteria: Assistant message bubbles expose a Copy answer action.
Tapping Copy answer writes that message's exact content to the iOS pasteboard.
The button visibly changes to Copied after activation.
User message bubbles do not show the copy-answer action.
Existing Share answer and text selection remain available.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
Verify pasteboard behavior on a physical iPhone before claiming device acceptance.
recovery: If pasteboard behavior is unavailable in a test environment, keep the copy action isolated to the assistant bubble and retain text selection and Share answer as fallbacks.
